name: Roetten Stonehammer
summary: Roetten Stonehammer works from the Library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. He represents Reclaimers Inc., organizing expeditions and hiring adventurers for salvage work in distant lands such as Desolace.

sections.title: Business in the Library
sections.body: In the Hall of Explorers' Library, Roetten Stonehammer handles practical recovery for Reclaimers Inc. He connects mercenaries with salvage work across Kalimdor. His associates seek valuable cargo, wreckage, and rare reagents in dangerous lands such as Desolace.

faq.answer: Roetten Stonehammer works in the Library of Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. The dwarf coordinates expeditions and finds adventurers for Reclaimers Inc.'s recovery work abroad.
Reclaimers Inc. salvages lost shipments, gathers rare reagents, and investigates valuable wrecks in dangerous lands such as Desolace.
Roetten sends travelers across the sea to Desolace in western Kalimdor. His partners seek shipwreck salvage and reagents along its rugged coast and barren wilderness.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can find Roetten in Ironforge's grand archives, where archaeological curiosity meets commercial salvage.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Roetten in Ironforge for expeditions across the sea to Desolace in Kalimdor.
